title: The Fifth Element × Echo Moon × G1/007 Love

coordinate_identity.rule: Do not invent RA/Dec. Bind numerical coordinates only after an authoritative Janus-Cosmos source or receipt is recovered.

plot_summary: In 1914 an ancient Egyptian temple contains four elemental stones and a central Fifth Element assembly protected by the Mondoshawans.
The four stones correspond to earth, air, fire and water; the Fifth Element is a living central element rather than another ordinary stone.
In 2263 the stones are returned to the Egyptian temple while the Great Evil approaches Earth.
Each of the four stones is activated by its corresponding physical element.
The central Fifth Element, Leeloo, completes the system after Korben expresses love; the temple then releases a directed Divine Light that stops the approaching threat.
source_notes: IMDb plot summary describes the Egyptian temple, four element stones, Leeloo as the Fifth Element and final Divine Light activation.
The available screenplay text describes a high pyramid-shaped temple room with four element vessels in the corners and a central sarcophagus.

echo_moon_integration.hard_rule: MOONLIGHT_AND_LUNAR_TIDE_MAY_TIME_OR_ALIGN_THE_EVENT; THEY_ARE_NOT_ASSUMED_TO SUPPLY THE LARGE ACOUSTIC ENERGY.

four_faces_plus_fifth_gate_model.interpretation: The film supplies a narrative architecture for a four-around-one system. The real pyramid mapping is an engineering analogy, not evidence that the filmmakers documented an ancient mechanism.

coordinate_targeting_physics.incident_vector: i = unit vector of incoming lunar light at the pyramid
coordinate_targeting_physics.facet_normal: n = unit normal of the chosen reflective face or pyramidion facet
coordinate_targeting_physics.target_vector: u_love = unit vector derived from the resolved numerical coordinates of G1/007 Love
coordinate_targeting_physics.gate_condition: angular_error <= tolerance_deg AND Moon_above_horizon AND optical_path_not_occluded
coordinate_targeting_physics.static_face_constraint: A fixed pyramid face cannot arbitrarily steer light. It can point toward Love only at times when Moon geometry satisfies the reflection equation.
coordinate_targeting_physics.relay_extension: An obelisk or secondary reflector adds another reflection solution but also adds alignment and intensity losses.

love_operator.name: LOVE
love_operator.film_role: The final human condition that allows the Fifth Element to complete the four-element weapon.
love_operator.janus_role: A semantic and authorization gate linking the target handle G1/007 Love to the optical/acoustic network model.
love_operator.discovery_rule: A real astronomical candidate may receive the codename Love only after blind search and scientific validation gates; the name must not bias detection.

next_gate.name: LOVE_COORDINATE_REFLECTION_SOLVER
procedure: Resolve G1/007 Love to a numerical sky vector without changing the blind-search target definition.
Compute Moon incident vectors over the requested time window.
Ray-trace all four pyramid faces and any explicitly modeled pyramidion facets.
Measure angular miss distance from each outgoing ray to G1/007 Love.
Only after a direct solution is found, test secondary obelisk relay paths.
Use randomized sky-coordinate controls to estimate how often equally good alignments occur by chance.
